name: doMINO_aero_ctrl_safety_wrapper
description: Synthesizable ASIC safety wrapper that manages deterministic control, request sequencing, freshness checking, clamp/slew limiting, fallback management, and fault supervision around an external DoMINO aero model service. The block does not implement the physics surrogate model and never invents surrogate outputs; it only accepts validated model responses and produces bounded actuator commands or safe fallback commands.

fixed_assumptions: All arithmetic is fixed-point and synthesizable.
No floating-point, dynamic memory, or unbounded loops are permitted.
The external DoMINO model service may be remote and unavailable; the wrapper must remain safe and deterministic.

Request freshness threshold, clamp bounds, optional slew limits, and fallback vector are parameterized as synthesis-time parameters or small CSR-like configuration inputs suitable for ASIC integration.

functionality: This IP block is a deterministic safety wrapper between vehicle/flow inputs and an external DoMINO aero model service. It accepts geometry metadata and flow conditions only when vehicle geometry is valid and stream velocity is within the inclusive envelope of 20 to 55 m/s. It packages only validated metadata into a model_request_valid strobe for external orchestration, while maintaining an internal request/response sequence counter, freshness checking, response completeness checking, clamp/slew limiting, and safe fallback control. The block does not calculate physics surrogate outputs, does not infer model results, and does not depend on software execution. When responses are stale, incomplete, invalid, missing, out of sequence, out of freshness threshold, or when actuator_enable_in is deasserted, the block must remain or transition to fallback and suppress actuator_command_valid.
responsibilities: Initialize to safe fallback mode on reset.
Validate flow envelope and geometry presence before allowing request issuance.
Generate deterministic request sequencing and hold off new requests while one is outstanding.
Reject stale, missing, incomplete, or mismatched responses.
Apply local deterministic fusion and policy logic only after validated response completeness.
Saturate actuator command outputs to programmable clamp bounds before asserting valid.
Optionally apply slew-rate limiting using registered previous-command state and bounded deltas.
Provide sticky fault reporting with explicit clear on reset only in this contract.
Remain safe under model unavailability or remote worker latency.
Never assert actuator_command_valid from model_response_valid alone.
reset_behavior: On reset_n deassertion, the block shall enter safe fallback mode, clear outstanding request tracking, clear request sequence state, clear response acceptance state, deassert actuator_command_valid, deassert model_request_valid, and drive fallback_active high. Sticky fault bits shall be cleared to their reset defaults. The fallback command vector shall reset to deterministic constants or CSR-programmed defaults, and previous-command state used for slew limiting shall be initialized to those defaults.
behavior_rules: The request state machine shall be synthesized from deterministic synchronous logic and may include states IDLE, REQUEST_SENT, WAIT_RESPONSE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, APPLY_CLAMP, OUTPUT, and FALLBACK.

A flow_conditions_valid request may only be considered if stream_velocity_mps is within 20 to 55 m/s inclusive; otherwise invalid_input and out_of-envelope flow fault behavior shall be asserted and fallback forced.
A request shall not be reissued while a previous request is outstanding and unaccepted.
model_request_valid is a one-cycle strobe or registered handshake output and must not imply model availability or command validity.
model_response_valid alone shall never directly cause actuator_command_valid to assert.

A response is acceptable only if model_response_seq matches the outstanding request sequence, model_response_age is within the programmed freshness threshold, and the required response completeness condition is met.

Response completeness requires drag_force_in and lift_force_in valid, plus either surface_pressure_in or flow_field_valid depending on the configured integration mode; incomplete responses shall be rejected and force fallback.
Deterministic aero decision fusion shall use only validated response data and local policy inputs, implemented in fixed-point combinational or pipelined logic.
All actuator_command_out values shall be clamped to configured min/max bounds before command valid is asserted.
If slew limiting is enabled, the command shall be rate-limited against the previous registered command using bounded per-cycle delta.
fault_status_out shall encode at minimum invalid_input, stale_response, timeout, clamp_active, fallback_active, and response_missing status bits.
Sticky fault bits shall be clearable only by reset or an explicit clear control if later added by integration; in this contract they are reset-cleared only.
If inference is not executed or no valid response is present, the block shall remain in fallback mode and shall not synthesize surrogate outputs.
Clock gating insertion shall preserve functionality by keeping all state updates enable-qualified and synchronous to clk.
The implementation shall tolerate remote DoMINO execution on NIM/GPU workers without loss of safe control.
All internal arithmetic, compares, saturates, freshness checks, and sequence checks shall be fixed-point and synthesizable.
